name: Laying On Of Hands
overview: The laying on of hands in Scripture serves as a significant means of imparting blessing, authority, healing, and the Holy Spirit. In Genesis 48:14, it is used to confer a blessing and designate leadership within a family. Deuteronomy 34:9 shows the transmission of wisdom and leadership from Moses to Joshua through this act. The Gospels in Mark 6:5 and Luke 4:40 reveal Jesus laying hands on the sick to bring physical healing. In the early church, as recorded in Acts 6:6 and 8:17, laying on of hands was practiced to set apart servants and to bestow the Holy Spirit, underscoring its spiritual and authoritative significance.
